g.text: Errors inside a digitally withheld tooth-surface patch
Fixed central location; radius 0.8 mm; predictions fitted before reference scoring
Shared scale: +/-0.5 mm vertical error. Orange: excess; blue: deficit; gray: unavailable.
M3#88 GLN04-289B-URM2; geometry test, not regenerated tooth material.
Le Luyer et al. 2016; Osteotheque de Pessac, Universite de Bordeaux; curator S. Rottier. CC BY-NC 4.0.
